title: Pumpkin Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic stew originating from Saudi Arabia, made with roasted pumpkin and spices.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the pumpkin and cook for about 5 minutes, or until slightly tender.
Add the tagine spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the coconut milk and vegetable broth, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for about 20 minutes, or until the pumpkin is tender.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
